product.title: Best of Barcelona: Sagrada Familia, Park Guell, Montjuic & Gothic

description.text: Make the most of your short time in Barcelona with this “best-of” tour. You’ll explore the architectural riches of the Gothic Quarter, dive deep into Catalan modernism, feast your eyes on the Sagrada Familia, and even skip the entrance lines. Stops include Gothic Quarter, Montjuïc, Park Güell, Sagrada Familia. Following your guide, you’ll not only save time—you’ll experience why Barcelona is one of the most-visited cities in the world. Ideal for visitors basing in Barcelona who want a guided city experience without coordinating metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
